spans.s:
Equal,Ⓒa.Ⓓsama, samAna, tulya, sadfSa (SI f.), pratima-saMkASa- in comp.; (with instr. or gen. of person); See Like; ‘to whom gold and a clod of earth are e(qual)’ sama-lozWakAMcanaH; the point of equality being in the instr. or loc.; samudreRa samo gAMBIrye-ryeRa; ‘to consider e(qual)’ tulayA Df 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 anavara.
Ⓑ
 3 samavftti-citta, nirvikAra.
Ⓑ
 4 paryApta, alaM with inf. or dat.; kxp 1 A (with dat.); ‘he is e(qual) to the task’ tatkAryaM sADayitumalaM saH; rakzaRAya kalpate, &c.
Ⓔs.ⒹsamAnapadasTaH, tulyapadaBAj m.
Ⓑ
 2 savayaskaH, savayasyaH, tulyavayas; oft. by (a.).
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓtul 10 (tulayati), (prAsA-dAstvAM tulayitumalaM

) samI-tulyI-kf 8 U; oft. ex. by (a.); ‘none can e(qual) me in bravery’ na kopi SOryeRa mama samAnaH.
Ⓝ[Equal]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹsAmyaM, samAnatA, tulyatA, sAdfSyaM, &c.
Ⓝ[Equal]ize,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsamIkf 8 U, tul 10.
Ⓝ[Equal]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsamaM, sadfSaM, samAnaM, tulyaM.

Equator,Ⓒs.ⒹBUkakzA, pariDiH, nirakzaH; ‘celestial e(quator)’ vyomakakzA.
Ⓝ[Equator]ial,Ⓒa.Ⓓnirakza in comp.; ‘e(quatorial) region’ nirakzadeSaH.

Equilibrium,Ⓒs.ⒹtulyatA, samatA, sAmyaM.
Ⓑ
 2 tulyaBAratA, samatolanaM; samAnaBaratvaM; ‘to be in e(quilibrium)’ tulya a. BU, tulayA Df pass. sa-mAnaBAra a. BU.

Equinox,Ⓒs.ⒹvizuvaM, vizuvat n.; ‘the vernal e(quinox)’ mahAvizuvaM, haripadaM; ‘the autumnal e(quinox)’ vizupadaM, jalavizuvaM.
ⓃEquinoctial,Ⓒa.ⒹvizuvIya; ‘e(quinoctial) line’ vizuvadvfttaM, vizumaMqalaM; ‘e(quinoctial) point’ ayanaM.

Equip,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsajjIkf 8 U, sarvopakaraRAni pra-upa-kxp c. or upapad c. or samAhf 1 P, upa-karaREH samAyuj 7 U, 10; ‘e(quip) with arms’ sannah c.; ‘e(quip) with clothes’ vastrEH saMvye 1 P or BUz 10.
Ⓝ[Equip]age,Ⓒs.ⒹupakaraRaM, sADanaM, saMBAraH, sAmagrI, upaskaraH.
Ⓑ
 2 paribarhaH, pari-vAraH.
Ⓑ
 3 sajjA, paricCadaH, sannAhaH, sajjanA, kalpanA, AkalpaH.
Ⓑ
 4 vAhanaM, vimAnaM, pravahaRaM.
Ⓝ[Equip]ment,Ⓒs.ⒹsajjA, saMBAraH, sajjIkaraRaM, sADanaM.

Equipoise,Ⓒv. i.ⒹsamIkf 8 U, tulayA Df 1 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹEquilibrium, q. v.

Equity,Ⓒs.ⒹnyAyaH, DarmaH, apakzapAtaH, nyAyyatA, sarvasamatA.
Ⓝ[Equit]able,Ⓒa.ⒹnyAyaparAyaRa-vartin, apakzapAtin, samadarSin, sarvasama-nyAyin.
Ⓑ
 2 nyAyya, yaTAnyAya, pakzapAtarahita, sarvasADAraRa.
Ⓝ[Equit]ableness,Ⓒs.ⒹnyAyyatA; apakza-pAtaH.
Ⓝ[Equit]ably,Ⓒadv.ⒹnyAyataH, yaTAnyAyaM, pakzapAtaM vinA.

Equivalent,Ⓒa.Ⓓsama, tulya; See Equal.
Ⓑ
 2 tulyArTaka, samArTa, tulyabalaSakti; tulya-sama-mUlya, samArGa.
Ⓔs.ⒹtulyadravyaM-vastu n., tulyamUlyaM vastu, pratiPalaM.
Ⓑ
 2 tulyArTaH SabdaH, paryAyaH.

Equivocal,Ⓒa.ⒹdvyarTa, saMdigDArTa, vakra, aspa-zwArTa, avyakta.
Ⓝ[Equivocal]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹvakroktyA, BaMgyA, aspazwaM, saMdigDArTena, avyaktaM.
Ⓝ[Equivocal]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMdigDArTaH, dvyarTatA, arTasaMdehaH, vakratA, aspazwatA.

Equivocate,Ⓒv. i.ⒹvakraM-aspazwArTaM-vad 1 P, vAkyaBedaM kf 8 U.
Ⓝ[Equivocat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹvakravacanaM, vakrokti f., vAkyaBedaH, vAkCalaM, apa-vyapa-deSaH.
